title: SDG 10 減少不平等
footer: Teacher Dom · SDG #10 Reduced Inequalities 減少不平等

slides.eyebrow_en: A Bilingual Lesson for Junior High Students

strip.zh: 全球目標，這是第 10 項
沒有人該被當作透明人

lines.en: I grew up in Compton, California.
lines.zh: 我在美國加州的 Compton 長大。

lines.en: People judged my town before they ever met me.
lines.zh: 在還沒認識我之前，人們就先用我住的地方評斷我。

lines.en: I won the UNA 2024 Young Leader of the Year Award.
lines.zh: 我獲得 2024 年聯合國協會青年領袖獎。

lines.en: Today: why fairness is not the same as sameness.
lines.zh: 今天要談：公平，並不等於一模一樣。

slides.ask_en: Raise your hand: has anyone ever guessed something wrong about you?
slides.ask_zh: 舉手：有沒有人曾經對你有過錯誤的猜測？

slides.note_en: Watch — then tell me one word you remember.
slides.note_zh: 看完之後，告訴我你記得的一個英文單字。

prompts.en: Stand up if you have ever been the new person somewhere.
prompts.zh: 曾經是某個地方的新來的人，站起來。

prompts.en: Stay standing if nobody talked to you that first day.
prompts.zh: 如果第一天沒有人跟你說話，繼續站著。

prompts.en: Sit down if someone finally did talk to you.
prompts.zh: 如果後來有人主動跟你說話了，請坐下。

slides.punch_en: That one person changed everything. Today, you can be that person.
slides.punch_zh: 那一個人改變了一切。今天，你可以當那個人。

slides.body_en: In 2015, every country agreed on 17 Global Goals for 2030. Goal 10 is Reduced Inequalities — no one should be left behind because of where they are from, what they look like, or what they have.
slides.body_zh: 2015 年，全世界所有國家訂下 17 項全球目標，要在 2030 年前達成。第 10 項是「減少不平等」——不該有人因為出身、長相或擁有的多寡而被丟下。

slides.q_en: Two students need to see over a wall. One is tall, one is short. What is FAIR?
slides.q_zh: 兩個學生要看過一道牆，一高一矮。怎樣才叫「公平」？

options.en: Give both the same size box
options.zh: 兩個人給一樣高的箱子

options.en: Give the shorter one a taller box
options.zh: 矮的那個給比較高的箱子

slides.explain_en: Equality gives everyone the same. Equity gives everyone what they need to reach the same view.
slides.explain_zh: 平等是「給一樣的」；公平是「給他所需要的」，讓大家都看得到一樣的風景。

slides.head_zh: 每 5 個人就有 1 人感受過被歧視
slides.body_en: Because of age, gender, skin color, disability, language, or where they live.
slides.body_zh: 原因可能是年齡、性別、膚色、身心障礙、語言，或住在哪裡。
slides.ask_en: Which of those could happen right here, in this classroom?
slides.ask_zh: 這些原因裡，哪幾個可能就發生在這間教室裡？

slides.q_en: Which of these is the BEST way to include a new classmate?
slides.q_zh: 下列哪一個是接納新同學最好的方法？

options.en: Tell them they can join if they want
options.zh: 跟他說他想加入的話可以來

options.en: Say their name and ask them to sit with you
options.zh: 叫出他的名字，請他坐你旁邊

options.en: Wait for them to ask you first
Tell the teacher to assign them a friend
options.zh: 請老師指派一個朋友給他

slides.explain_en: Using someone's name is the fastest way to make them feel real to you. An invitation beats permission.
slides.explain_zh: 叫出名字是讓對方覺得被看見最快的方法。「主動邀請」勝過「允許加入」。

slides.head_en: True or False? 快問快答

items.en: Treating everyone exactly the same is always fair.
items.zh: 對每個人一模一樣，就一定公平。
items.note_en: People start from different places — fair means giving what is needed.
items.note_zh: 每個人的起點不同，公平是給他需要的。

items.en: Leaving someone out can hurt as much as saying something mean.
items.zh: 把人排除在外，可能跟說難聽話一樣傷人。
items.note_en: Being ignored is one of the most common forms of bullying.
items.note_zh: 被忽略是最常見的霸凌形式之一。

items.en: Inequality only happens in poor countries.
items.zh: 不平等只發生在貧窮國家。
items.note_en: It happens everywhere — including the USA and Taiwan.
items.note_zh: 每個地方都有，包括美國和台灣。

items.en: One student speaking up can change how a whole class behaves.
items.zh: 一個學生出聲，就可能改變全班的氣氛。
items.note_en: Research calls this the first follower — the second person makes it safe.
items.note_zh: 研究稱為「第一個跟隨者」，第二個人讓這件事變安全。

slides.q_en: Someone is being left out at lunch. What helps MOST?
slides.q_zh: 午餐時有人被排擠，怎麼做幫助最大？

options.en: Tell others they are being mean
Go and sit with them yourself
options.zh: 自己走過去坐在他旁邊
在網路上發文講這件事

slides.explain_en: Sympathy changes nothing. Sitting down next to someone changes everything.
slides.explain_zh: 同情改變不了什麼，坐到他旁邊改變一切。

slides.rule_en: In 30 seconds, shout out as many countries in English as you can. I will count!
slides.rule_zh: 30 秒內，用英文喊出越多國家名越好，我來數！
slides.target_zh: 要打破的班級紀錄：15 個

slides.prompt_en: Tell your partner about a time someone made you feel welcome. What did they actually do?
slides.prompt_zh: 告訴隔壁同學：有沒有誰曾讓你覺得被歡迎？他實際上做了什麼？
slides.sentence_zh: 當有人 ______ 的時候，我覺得被歡迎。
slides.time_en: 60 seconds — then 3 pairs share with the class.
slides.time_zh: 60 秒，然後請 3 組跟全班分享。

slides.sub_en: Vote with your hands — 1, 2, 3, or 4 fingers.

items.zh: 記住並叫出別人的名字
邀請別人加入你的小組

items.en: Speak up when you hear a mean joke
items.zh: 聽到傷人的玩笑時出聲

items.en: Ask someone about their family's home town

slides.reveal_en: All four work. #3 is the hardest and the most powerful — it changes what the whole room thinks is okay.
slides.reveal_zh: 四個都有效。第 3 個最難也最有力量——它會改變整個班認為「可以接受」的界線。

slides.head_en: 3 Things You Can Do This Week
slides.head_zh: 這週你可以做的 3 件事

items.en: Learn the name of someone you rarely talk to.
items.zh: 記住一個你很少講到話的同學的名字。

items.en: Invite one person into something you're doing.
items.zh: 邀請一個人加入你正在做的事。

items.en: If a joke hurts someone, don't laugh.
items.zh: 如果一個玩笑傷到人，就不要跟著笑。

slides.q_zh: equity（公平）這個字是什麼意思？

options.zh: 每個人拿到完全一樣的東西
每個人拿到他所需要的

slides.explain_en: Equality = same. Equity = what each person needs. Remember the boxes and the wall.
slides.explain_zh: Equality 是一樣；Equity 是各取所需。想想剛才那道牆跟箱子。

slides.q_en: About how many languages are spoken in Taiwan?
slides.q_zh: 台灣大約有多少種語言在使用？
slides.explain_en: Mandarin, Taiwanese, Hakka and 16+ indigenous languages. Difference is normal here.
slides.explain_zh: 華語、台語、客語，加上 16 種以上的原住民族語。「不一樣」在這裡本來就是常態。

slides.head_zh: 加碼遊戲：接納還是排除？
slides.rule_en: I say an action. Thumbs UP = it includes people. Thumbs DOWN = it leaves someone out.
slides.rule_zh: 我說一個行為，大拇指向上＝接納，向下＝把人排除在外。

hints.en: An inside joke nobody else gets
Asking how to say a name correctly
hints.zh: 問對方名字怎麼唸才對

hints.en: A group chat that leaves one person out
hints.zh: 刻意少加一個人的群組

hints.en: Explaining the game rules to the new kid
hints.zh: 跟新同學解釋遊戲規則

hints.en: Copying someone's accent to be funny
Splitting teams so nobody is picked last
hints.zh: 分組時不讓任何人最後被挑

slides.target_en: Tap each item to reveal the answer.

slides.body_en: Go to our School Tour page and find the Beidou Junior High column. No sign-up, no login — just write your comment for Teacher Dom.
slides.body_zh: 到我們網站的 School Tour 頁面，找到北斗國中那一欄，免註冊、免登入，直接留言跟 Teacher Dom 互動。

slides.big_en:
Be kind, be brave,
be the change.
slides.big_zh: 善良、勇敢，成為那個改變。
